Background: This randomized phase 2 trial compared CAPOX plus bevacizumab with FOLFOXIRI plus bevacizumab in 796 patients with previously untreated MSI-high metastatic colorectal cancer.
Results: The objective response rate was 55.3% in the CAPOX plus bevacizumab arm versus 16.7% in the FOLFOXIRI plus bevacizumab arm.
